mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, provider, transaction_id, payment_intent_id, amount, currency, status, raw_response, created_at FROM payment_transaction WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, order_id, provider, transaction_id, payment_intent_id, amount, currency, status, raw_response, created_at FROM payment_transaction WHERE provider = #{provider} AND payment_intent_id = #{paymentIntentId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: pt.id, pt.order_id, mo.order_no, mo.user_id, su.username, su.realname, mo.product_id, mp.code AS plan_code, mp.name AS plan_name, product.cycle_type, pt.provider, pt.payment_intent_id, pt.transaction_id, pt.amount, pt.currency, pt.status AS payment_status, mo.status AS order_status, pt.created_at, mo.pay_time, mo.callback_time

FROM payment_transaction pt INNER JOIN member_order mo ON mo.id = pt.order_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = mo.user_id LEFT JOIN member_product product ON product.id = mo.product_id LEFT JOIN member_plan mp ON mp.id = product.plan_id
